verdict.rationale: Puzzle exposes an API and an MCP integration, so scoped/least-privilege credential issuance for agents is a fair question, but no evidence describes API key scoping, permission tiers, or agent-specific credential controls. The only related mention is that Puzzle's own inbound data integrations are read-only (puzzle-docs-25), which is about Puzzle reading external data, not about issuing scoped credentials to an agent consuming Puzzle's API.
